what: The licence and provenance review required by LICENSE_POLICY.md for every RUNTIME dependency of the application surface.
whyThisExists: Decision 1 of EP-010 M12. scripts/dependency-audit.sh used to fail the build while ANY runtime dependency existed, citing LICENSE_POLICY.md for the supply-chain reasoning. The policy does not require the absence of runtime dependencies: it requires each one to be pinned and to carry an SPDX identifier, provenance, attribution, a security review and a compatibility verdict. All eleven runtime dependencies are MIT, which the policy's own table lists as Permitted. The invariant was therefore corrected to enforce the policy AS WRITTEN - and what it gives up is stated in the correction rather than dropped: the claim that the shipped application has no third-party runtime supply chain is WITHDRAWN, while the claim that a CONSUMER can install and run the installer with no third-party runtime dependency is KEPT and enforced below.
reviewer: repository owner (the entry set was approved with Decision 1). An agent may PRUNE nothing from this file: a dependency that disappears from it fails the gate.
